The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Smada]] employed several minions from the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]], among whom was '''one''' who accompanied the Hutt in an outdoor confrontation with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]]. When Smada ordered the Gank to attack the children, the minion mysteriously disappeared.
